description: 双兵对峙⑤：通路兵升变 — 白方a7通路兵立即升变，黑方无法阻止

intro.popup_en: White's passed a-pawn is already on the seventh rank, and the black king on e5 is too far away to stop it. The white g-pawn also restrains Black's h-pawn.
intro.popup: 💡 通路兵升变：白方 a7 通路兵已在七线，黑王（e5）距 a8 太远，无法阻止白兵升变。g1 兵牵制黑方 h5。

outro.popup_en: White wins. The new queen captures the black c-pawn and then controls the h-pawn, leaving Black with no counterplay.
outro.popup: ✅ 结论：白胜！ 白后吃掉黑方 c8 兵，再控制 h 兵，白胜定局。

moves.popup_en: 1...Kd6: the black king approaches, but cannot stop promotion.
moves.popup: 1...Kd6 — 黑王靠近，但已无法阻挡。

moves.popup_en: 2. Qxc8 captures the black c-pawn and removes its counterplay.
moves.popup: 2.Q×c8 — 白后吃掉黑 c8 兵！消除威胁。

moves.popup_en: 2...h4 is Black's only attempt at counterplay.
moves.popup: 2...h4 — 黑方唯一反抗：h 兵推进。

moves.popup_en: 3. g2: the white pawn is also ready to promote and controls the black pawn.
moves.popup: 3.g2 — g 兵升变在即，同时控制黑兵。

moves.popup_en: 3...h3: the black pawn pushes desperately, but it is too late.
moves.popup: 3...h3 — 黑兵拼命推进，已无济于事。

moves.popup_en: 4. g3: White responds calmly and keeps a clear advantage.
moves.popup: 4.g3 — 白方从容应对，优势明显。
